Gunmaggedon experimental build
Runtime helper: 1.6.0
Blueprinter asset pack: 0.0.7

Copy this folder's BepInEx contents into the game's BepInEx directory with the
game closed. Back up your current installation/config first, and move older
Gunmageddon .nobp packs outside plugins so only one current pack is loaded.
Both the DLL and .nobp are required. Restart the game to load the update.

Requires a working Nuclear Option BepInEx/Blueprinter setup. Dependencies and
native game assemblies are not bundled here. See the repository README.

Compilation and six standalone suites passed. AP mission damage/balance,
latest query changes, multiplayer and live CIWS engagement remain unverified.
This is an experimental snapshot, not a claim of complete in-game validation.
